phase: Phase 2: Marketing App Public Workflow Security

critical_fixed.title: test-connection route had no auth guard
critical_fixed.description: POST /api/settings/test-connection accepted unauthenticated requests, allowing anyone to probe LLM connections without credentials.
critical_fixed.fix: Added requireMarketingSession guard before AI call; re-exported redactSecrets from shared lib.

critical_fixed.title: Settings page did not load existing values on mount
critical_fixed.description: The settings page initialized all fields to empty defaults. After the masking hardening (GET returns ... for secrets), users could not see which keys were configured.
critical_fixed.fix: Added useEffect to fetch GET /api/settings on mount; displays 'configured — enter a new value to change' label when secret is masked.

critical_fixed.title: Frontend fetch calls did not handle 401
critical_fixed.description: All frontend fetch calls caught errors generically but did not check for 401 status. On session expiry, users would see error messages instead of being redirected to login.
critical_fixed.fix: Added res.status === 401 checks with window.location.href = /login redirect in all 9 fetch call sites across 3 pages.

critical_fixed.title: 401 response shape standardized
critical_fixed.description: The auth guard returned { message: 'Authentication required' } which was inconsistent with the { message: 'Unauthorized' } contract.

test_fixes.title: phase-3-settings.test.ts: test-connection tests used unauthenticated requests
test_fixes.description: Two test-connection integration tests created plain Request objects without session cookies, causing 401 after the auth guard was added to the route.
test_fixes.fix: Replaced new Request(...) with authedRequest(...) from helpers/auth-mock.ts.

test_fixes.title: phase-3-settings-adversarial.test.ts: error-body test used unauthenticated request
test_fixes.description: The API key leakage test created a plain Request, causing 401 instead of reaching the error redaction path.

known_failures.title: phase-1-boot-adversarial: SQL specificity timeout
known_failures.description: Intermittent timeout on db.execute mock — passes on ~50% of runs. Pre-existing Vitest mock isolation issue, not a contract regression.

known_failures.title: phase-w3-video-auth: research-topics positive control mock isolation
known_failures.description: Intermittent failure where the AI client mock is not applied to the route's @/lib/ai re-export. Passes on ~50% of runs. Pre-existing test infrastructure issue.

contract_verification.api_contract_stability: All 7 guarded API routes (settings GET/POST, campaigns GET/POST, campaigns/[id] GET/PATCH, video/save-topics POST, video/research-topics POST, video/generate-script POST, video/projects GET/POST) return consistent JSON shapes. Settings POST still encrypts secrets before DB insert. Settings GET still masks secrets for authenticated callers.
contract_verification.error_response_shape: 401 returns { message: 'Unauthorized' } consistently. 400 returns { message: string, error?: string }. 500 returns { message: string }. No raw redirects, no HTML.
contract_verification.zod_400_responses: All mutating routes validate with Zod schemas and return structured 400 errors before any DB/AI side effects.
contract_verification.masking_ux: GET /api/settings returns '••••' for apiKey (distinguishable from empty/null). Settings page loads on mount and shows 'configured — enter a new value to change' label when masked value is present.
contract_verification.frontend_401_handling: All 9 fetch call sites across 3 pages now check res.status === 401 and redirect to /login. No infinite-retry patterns.
contract_verification.no_broken_imports: check-types passes. No dangling imports of removed provider code.
